lines: This plan covers 3 days, starting Wednesday 2026-08-19.
You cook on Tuesday and Saturday, and that is what was kept.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.

dishes.name: Jam toast eggs
dishes.title: Toast with blackcurrant jam, egg frittata and roast potatoes
dishes.method: Toast the bread. Serve with blackcurrant jam for Odalric and Peregrine, and crustless toast for Wilfrid and Casimir. Reheat the egg frittata and roast potatoes, then plate them alongside the toast.
dishes.why: A named breakfast with a warm element keeps the week anchored and fits the coach's rule that breakfast can be small and warm.

dishes.name: Traybake lunch bowls
dishes.title: Roast chicken, rice, roast courgettes and peppers, and yoghurt sauce
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken, rice and vegetables in a pan with a splash of water, then finish with yoghurt sauce and lemon. Keep the portions as boxed for each person, with Peregrine's vegetables chosen from the non-carrot tray.
dishes.why: This uses one cooked batch for a large lunch and gives the loud vegetable the lead without needing extra cooking on a busy day.

dishes.name: Herby chicken dinner
dishes.title: Roast chicken, roast potatoes, roast courgettes and peppers, and yoghurt sauce
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken, potatoes and vegetables in a pan, then add yoghurt sauce and lemon at the table. Serve Peregrine's plate without any fennel and keep Wilfrid's bread separate if he wants it.
dishes.why: It gives a warm dinner from the same session and varies the second main meal so the week does not feel repetitive.

dishes.name: Window toast breakfast
dishes.title: Toast with blackcurrant jam, egg frittata and roast potatoes
dishes.method: Toast the bread, spread the jam for Odalric and Peregrine, and serve the crustless slices for Wilfrid and Casimir. Reheat the egg frittata and potatoes from their boxes.
dishes.why: Thursday needs a quick breakfast because the kitchen table is under a dust sheet and the coach wants breakfast present, not absent.

dishes.name: Hallway lunch bowls
dishes.title: Roast chicken, rice, roast courgettes and peppers, and yoghurt sauce
dishes.method: Reheat the boxed chicken, rice and vegetables in a pan, then spoon over yoghurt sauce and lemon. Keep the portions ready so the dust sheet does not turn lunch into a faff.
dishes.why: It gives a full lunch without needing the shared table or extra cooking while the hallway is being painted.

dishes.name: Dust-sheet chicken dinner
dishes.title: Roast chicken, roast potatoes, roast courgettes and peppers, and yoghurt sauce
dishes.method: Reheat the boxed chicken, potatoes and vegetables in a pan, then finish with yoghurt sauce and lemon. Serve the plates straight away so the shared kitchen stays manageable.
dishes.why: It reuses the same batch on the next day, staying within the coach's cooking rhythm and the fridge safety window.

dishes.name: Cold-weather breakfast tray
dishes.title: Toast with blackcurrant jam, egg frittata and roast potatoes
dishes.method: Toast the bread, spread the jam for Odalric and Peregrine, and keep Wilfrid's slices crustless. Reheat the egg frittata and roast potatoes from their boxes.
dishes.why: Friday breakfast is another warm, low-effort plate that keeps the week moving before the next cooking session.

dishes.name: Rice bowl lunch
dishes.title: Roast chicken, rice, roast courgettes and peppers, and yoghurt sauce
dishes.method: Reheat the boxed chicken, rice and vegetables in a pan, then add yoghurt sauce and lemon. This is the last use of the Wednesday batch, so keep the boxes moving and the portions even.
dishes.why: It finishes the Wednesday cook within the safe three-day window and keeps starch where the training is.

dishes.name: Friday chicken dinner
dishes.title: Roast chicken, roast potatoes, roast courgettes and peppers, and yoghurt sauce
dishes.method: Reheat the boxed chicken, potatoes and vegetables in a pan, then add yoghurt sauce and lemon. Serve Peregrine's plate without any fennel and give Casimir's plate his hot sauce separately if he wants it.
dishes.why: It gives dinner from the same session without a fourth distinct cook, which keeps the plan realistic and varied.

preparations.title: Roast chicken thighs
preparations.method: Heat the oven to 220 C. Toss the thighs with oil, paprika, crushed garlic, salt and pepper, spread on two trays and roast until browned and cooked through. Rest, then box straight away in meal portions.

preparations.title: Roast courgettes and peppers
preparations.method: Roast the courgettes, peppers and onions with oil, thyme and salt on a hot tray until tender and a little charred. Cool briefly, then box for the next three days.

preparations.title: Basmati rice
preparations.method: Rinse the rice, simmer it until fluffy, then spread it out to steam off. Box the cooked rice the same day it is made and keep it for lunch only on Wednesday and Friday.

preparations.title: Roast potatoes
preparations.method: Cut the potatoes into chunks, toss with oil, rosemary and salt, then roast until crisp at the edges. Box the cooked potatoes for breakfasts and dinners within the next three days.

preparations.title: Lemon herb yoghurt sauce
preparations.method: Stir the yoghurt with lemon zest and juice, finely chopped parsley, grated garlic, salt and pepper. Box cold; it is spooned over the hot food at meal time.

preparations.title: Courgette and herb egg frittata
preparations.method: Fry the courgette and spring onions briefly, add beaten eggs and cheddar, then cook gently until set and finish under the grill if needed. Cool, cut into portions and box for breakfast.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Heat the oven and get two trays in for the chicken and potatoes. While they roast, cook the rice on the hob, then stir together the yoghurt sauce. Use a pan for the egg frittata while the trays finish, then box the rice, chicken, vegetables, potatoes, sauce and frittata into named boxes for the next three days.
